title: Squaring-branch Frobenius-class rho in GT: trace-invariant branch bits and six +-pair keys, W=2^125.725, claim 125.73

claims.statement: For the supplied nonidentity Q in BLS12-381 G2 and uniform z in GT, compute g=e(P0,Q), recover z=g^x by a Frobenius-class rho walk in GT and return [x]P0 verified against e(P,Q)=z. Steps are one dense Fp12 multiplication, or a cyclotomic squaring taken with probability 3/8; branch, multiplier index and distinguished-point bits are read from the free class invariant T=Re(c0), and the twelve keys are computed as six +-pairs with four Fp multiplications. Total work is at most 2^(12573/100)=2^125.73 dense-Fp12 equivalents (computed 2^125.725) at C=20000, with success probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed random-mapping heuristic H1 and the pseudorandomness of the trace bits H2. The gate seen at submission time is 125.74 (747ad6c9), so this claim is 0.01 below it.
